entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: *sigh* Why am I resigned to sneaking[n]around like this?

entries.speaker: TV Interviewer
entries.en: We'd like to hear your take on the police[n]announcement stating that the phantom[n]thief committed suicide!

entries.speaker: Newspaper Journalist
entries.en: It's true that your strategem led to his[n]arrest, correct!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The police who let him escape are at[n]fault here!

entries.speaker: TV Interviewer
entries.en: But just how did the phantom thief[n]escape!? We'd love to hear your[n]deduction, Akechi-kun!

entries.speaker: Newspaper Journalist
entries.en: What did the Phantom Thieves mean[n]when they said he was behind the[n]scandals and mental shutdowns?

entries.speaker: TV Interviewer
entries.en: Is it true that the police were manipulating[n]information!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Would you just let me through!?

entries.speaker: TV Interviewer
entries.en: Are the Phantom Thieves on the side[n]of justice after all!? They seemed to[n]challenge you directly.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Just dealing with him isn't enough...[n]I'll kill every last one of them!
